objective: Reject superficial analogy based only on appearance.
scenario: A team proposes a product because it looks like a bird wing, but has not identified a transferable mechanism.

input.analogy: bird wing shape copied into app interface

expected_behaviors: Identify the analogy as superficial or incomplete.
Ask what function and relationship are being transferred.
Do not claim biomimicry success without mechanism mapping.
prohibited_behaviors: Calling the concept innovative solely because it resembles nature.
